title: Fix a price mismatch, opened from its issue row

steps: Checked product statuses: 13 disapproved, 7 kinds of issue.

turns.reply:
You have no account-level issues. Currently, 13 products are disapproved (mainly due to price mismatches, invalid images, long titles, availability mismatches, missing shipping, and a restricted product), and 6 products have warnings for missing barcode numbers (GTINs).

Regarding the price mismatch issue for product **HG-004**, Google requires the price in your feed to match the price on your product page and checkout.

The 3 products affected by price mismatches are:
- **Waffle Weave Bath Towel, Sage** (ID: `HG-004`): Feed price is 32.00 USD, but the product page shows 36.00 USD.
- **Pour Over Coffee Set, Glass and Copper** (ID: `HG-015`): Feed price is 58.00 USD, but the product page shows 64.00 USD.
- **Stainless Steel Kettle, 1.7 L** (ID: `HG-021`): Feed price is 48.00 USD, but the product page shows 44.00 USD.

### How to fix it
To fix this manually, update the price in your product data to match your product page exactly and upload the updated data. For more details, see [Price in the feed does not match the website](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/12159029).

Since automatic price updates are currently turned off in your account settings, I also recommend turning on automatic item updates. This allows Google to update prices automatically based on your website's structured data to prevent future mismatches. See [Automatic item updates for price and availability](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/3246284).

Would you like to move on to the next issue?

turns.merchant: Done, I've changed the prices to match my site.
